steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: If I recall correctly it's my lunch break now, so any interrogation will have to wait until—

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I'm not here for that.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's you...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: What now? Does Rhodes Island want to trample on my corpse too? By all means.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I'm only here on behalf of Ms. Candela to inform you of Dossoles's decision on how to handle you.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: The Dossoles Mayoral Office has determined that they will not try you for your crimes.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Let me guess. You're handing me over to the Coalition government?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Mateo's an idiot, but he's still the Coalition's representative in Dossoles.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Hmm... I've toyed with him so much the Coalition is probably itching to tear me apart.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: That's an accurate reading of your situation. The Coalition government wants to haul you to La Unidad for a trial, just like Mateo.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: A public trial? Great, I'm looking forward to it.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: No, Señor Reynell.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: You're being sent back to Kazimierz.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: ...Come again?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: The General Chamber of Commerce is pressuring Candela to send you back to Kazimierz.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: COME AGAIN?!

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Your father's KGCC contacts pulled some strings, and you no longer have to remain in Dossoles. So instead of heading to La Unidad, you can go home.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No... I'm not going back.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I'm not going back to that utterly despicable, depraved, and deplorable...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: You don't have a say here, Señor Reynell. It's your own reckless actions bringing you wherever your final destination may be.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: You have to swallow your medicine, be it sweet or bitter.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Old man... You're never going to leave me alone, are you?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Right, there's one more thing. You need to decide where your assets are going.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You say it like I have a choice in the matter. Hasn't Candela already used all the methods at her disposal to move them elsewhere?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: There are some... fixed assets that nobody dares to take...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Just write any name on this transfer contract.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Fine... I'll just write the name of whoever wanders by next—

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Señor Diaz, what are you doing here?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Identifying Mateo's men. The ones who were playing hostage earlier. And you? What did you call me for? Need something?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: N-No.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Adios, then.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Say... you... anyway, you haven't given a name yet, right? You can always take back what you—

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I never go back on my word.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Besides... this isn't such a bad choice.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Let a genuine art lover have it.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Reynell really put that old firefighter's name on it?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Yes. I confirmed it one last time as I was escorting him out of Dossoles, and he didn't change his mind.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: He really inherited none of his father's qualities.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Honestly, he would probably appreciate that evaluation.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Of course, but I didn't mean it as a compliment.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: Lady Candela. Your coffee, as well as Ernesto's.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: The aroma is so strong! What beans did you use for this, Señor Booker?

steps.name: Mayor's Bodyguard
steps.text: A triple dark roast blend Lady Candela has been drinking lately. Please enjoy.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Any plans to catch up with old friends now that everything has died down?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I wasn't intending to bother anyone before I got to the city, actually.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Indeed you wouldn't have, if that whole ruckus didn't happen. But you know how it is in Dossoles. Never a quiet day for us.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Just like now, Reynell's antics have dealt a heavy blow to the Coalition government's influence.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: La Unidad has been issuing letters of protest, but they can only dream of getting Reynell and his assets. Dossoles is not at their beck and call.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: The other two factions are also itching to get their hands on him—

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Oh, look at me. I seem to have slipped into a meaningless ramble.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: No, not at all, this is very important information.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Alright, Ernesto. Have a taste and see if this blend is to your liking.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: It's so strong... but the texture is fantastic.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Do elaborate.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I can discern each bean's species and aroma, but I can't tell which bean has the biggest ratio in the blend.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: All three aromas are fighting to come out on top, but soon they all converge into a strong and unified caramelized flavor.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Precisely.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: The main selling point of this blend is that the blend ratio isn't set in stone, but you still get that caramel flavor as long as their proportions are roughly balanced.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: So, does it suit your taste?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Still can't decide?

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: It's alright, the shop is just over there. You can always try a second cup, as long as you come back.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: They'll even modify the blend to your ideal ratio, or you can ask them to brew you a cup with sparkling water.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Haha, you're joking.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: A joke? I wouldn't say so.

steps.name: Candela
steps.text: Because I really am looking forward to seeing what you choose, Ernesto.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yo, Ernesto. Your chat with Mayor Candela took forever.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I had no choice. We go way back and have too many things to talk about.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: She must still like you if you guys talked for that long.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: I guess so.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hmph... always clamping up so fast whenever it's time to talk about you.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Fine, since you're so unwilling to talk, I don't have to ask you, hehe...

spans.text: Fine, since you're so unwilling to talk, I don't have to ask

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Rafaela won't tell you, even if you ask.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How did you know I was gonna ask her? Do you have mind-reading Arts or something?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: It's written all over your face.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ooh, scary man we have here.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: By the way, I already knew this morning we would be late, and I appreciate that you've been waiting for me the whole time, but we've already missed our appointment with Diaz, you know?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: —Oh, shit!

steps.name: A General Chamber of Commerce Employee
steps.text: Well then, Mr. Reynell Kowalski. Please get in the car while I fetch your luggage.
Reynell sits in the back with a blank expression. The door shuts, and it feels slightly warm, so he takes off his coat and leans back as he begins to loosen his collar.
A strange noise outside the car interrupts him, and he turns to look out the window. The General Chamber of Commerce employee lies on the ground, unconscious.
He then hears a tapping noise from the opposite window, and follows the sound to see a familiar face standing outside the car.
Reynell rolls down the window and sees a pair of dark eyes.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Mind giving me a ride, sir?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: And where are you wanting to go?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Hasn't that always been up to you to decide?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: You've been following me for a while, so maybe this time you take the lead and decide our destination.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Do you really have nowhere you want to go, Miłosz?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: It'll be the same as before, no matter where we go, yes?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Things are different this time. I'm broke, aside from the two suitcases in the trunk.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Then I'll drive until our fuel runs out, and we'll go wherever the car takes us.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Well... fine, you're the one in charge now.
Miłosz smiles at Reynell, and gets into the driver's seat, looking at the other face through the rearview mirror before starting the engine.
There is a blend of confusion, delight and a slight hint of hesitation on Reynell's face.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: You seem like you have something to ask me.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Why did you come back? Why didn't you leave?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Don't you already know the answer?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Maybe my question was to confirm that answer.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Don't be so sure. My patience might run out on you and you'll find I leave pretty soon.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: But not today.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: No, not today.
Miłosz looks away from the mirror, starts the engine, and the silver car sets off.
Galería Krysztauowa's exhibition hall is still the same as it was the other day.
Shattered glass cases, scorched ground, cracks in the walls; colorful spotlights, wanton graffiti, and frantic music going wild...
Everything is the same except the additional presence of a big round table in the center of the room.
A grill sizzles on the table at the perfect temperature, emanating an enticing aroma.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Well, why isn't anyone ordering? Not hungry?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I didn't expect you to turn the place into a barbecue restaurant.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Hah. The building got bombed into a war zone, and the art can't stay here anymore. So I thought, we might as well turn it into a side gig instead of leaving it empty.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: The TV stations in Dossoles lost their money-maker Reynell, so now they've started sticking their noses here and spreading rumors that none of our artists can cook and just survive on dried cactus.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: So I have to show them what true Bolívarian cuisine is!

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Then, I'll have one of those onion and mushroom meat skewers—

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Make it two.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Coming right up!

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Hmm... Mr. Diaz's really good at this.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I have to be honest, we've traveled all over Terra, but this is the first time we've tasted Bolívarian BBQ.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Where have you all been?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: We started from the Sargonian desert, and after a brief stay on Rhodes Island where we got our 'Team Rainbow' moniker, we each went off to a few more places.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: The rainforests of Sargon, the icefields of Sami, Columbia's mines and cities, villages in the Ursus taiga...

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Even so, we've only ever set foot on a small piece of these lands.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: My only regret is burying Levi Klitschko under the sands of Sargon along with his mad lab.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If you're homesick, you'll have to start thinking of a different way to go back.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Have you found one?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: (shrugs) Not even a lead.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: I guess you wouldn't mind a few more traveling companions on your quest?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Hahaha. The more the merrier!

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Uh, Lord, what is that...?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Everyone, let me, on behalf of Lord, introduce this 'Ursus Specialty Beverage'—
There is a sudden noise outside the window.
The members of Team Rainbow turn their heads full of food and drink toward the source of the noise, wondering what kind of trouble has erupted this time—
And then, the first one to realize what is going on shrugs in resignation.

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Papá says it's our turn to dance our Vulpo minuet today, so turn off your classical music!

steps.name: Destitute Noble
steps.text: But Tecno says she likes our triple meter waltz! Go and ask her if you don't believe me, she's over by the wall!

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Yeah, exactly!

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Come over here, Tecno. What do you make of this?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Hmph, don't bother me with this kinda stuff!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: If you can spare the time to argue over what music to play, then maybe take a look at my work!

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Your work? But your hand...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Oh, just come over and you'll see.

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Wow! You... you drew this yourself?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Haha! I practiced a lot, and I'm finally used to drawing with my left hand—

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Forget about the doodles and get your butt inside, Tecno! You have to try this 'Ursus Specialty Beverage' before they down the last drop of it! It's truly something else!
